items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1961-06-28
items.q: Jimmy Palau played Bobby. I believe he's dead.

ctx.x: Did you have a violin in your band that everyone wanted to?
Um, yeah, we did. That's right. We had, we had Jimmy Palau. Oh, yeah. Jimmy Palau played Bobby. I believe he's dead.
Yeah, I never really get the door ever hearing.
